description:
One hash-chain audit entry as an event — field for field the INT-016
``AuditEntry`` (packages/intake_platform/src/intake_platform/audit.py),
which is the source of truth for this shape (invariant 4: every read/
share audited; the chain makes editing detectable).

action.description: Dotted action name, e.g. note.read (INT-016 AuditEntry.action).
action.title: Action

consent_scope_ref.description: Consent scope that authorised the action (INT-016 AuditEntry.consent_scope_ref; invariant 4).
consent_scope_ref.title: Consent Scope Ref

prev_hash.description: SHA-256 of the predecessor entry (INT-016 AuditEntry.prev_hash).
prev_hash.title: Prev Hash

resource_ref.description: Resource acted on, as an id (INT-016 AuditEntry.resource_ref).
resource_ref.title: Resource Ref

schema_id.description: Versioned event id per the TS schemaId convention.
schema_id.title: Schema Id

timestamp_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant exactly as hashed (INT-016 AuditEntry.timestamp_utc — part of the hashed material, so it travels verbatim, never reformatted).
timestamp_utc.title: Timestamp Utc

title: AuditV1
